description: Zones retenues dans le dispositif de couverture mobile NewDeal is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Collectivité de Corse. Cartographie des zones retenues par l'équipe projet co-présidée par la Préfecture de Corse et la Collectivité de Corse dans le cadre du dispositif de couverture ciblée NewDeal. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Digital and Telecommunications. Its keywords are téléphone mobile. The portal shows 31 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-06-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
